summary: Revision 3: fixed the single open finding REV-1. The approved responsive-layout package defaults its pane to a light background because no ZestLayoutThemeProvider wraps it, so in the default dark theme the dialog title/body kept the app's light text colours on a white pane (~1.05:1). SidePane now passes the pane the app theme's own CSS variables on the package's sidePane element (inline background var(--panel), color var(--text), --zest-pane-bg/--zest-pane-divider/--zest-pane-close* from --panel/--border/--text/--accent), so every dialog building on it (confirmations, theme finder, update, help) and the branch menu are readable in the default dark theme and in every other built-in or custom theme. No dialog content, actions or close paths changed. Added one R8 test in SidePane.test.tsx proving the pane takes the app panel/text colours; all earlier tests are unchanged. npm run lint, the focused suites and the full window suite (551 tests, 51 files) pass.
